 37         }                                                                                                           
 36     }                                                                                                               
 35     gb.gap = position                                                                                               
 34 }                                                                                                                   
 33                                                                                                                     
 32 func (gb *GapBuffer) Delete(start, end int) {                                                                       
 31     if start < 0 || end > gb.size || start >= end {                                                                 
 30         return                                                                                                      
 29     }                                                                                                               
 28     copy(gb.data[start:], gb.data[end:gb.size])                                                                     
 27     gb.size -= (end - start)                                                                                        
 26     gb.gap -= (end - start)                                                                                         
 25 }                                                                                                                   
 24                                                                                                                     
 23 func (gb *GapBuffer) Insert(runes []rune) {                                                                         
 22     for _, r := range runes {                                                                                       
 21         if gb.size < len(gb.data) {                                                                                 
 20             gb.data[gb.gap] = r                                                                                     
 19             gb.gap++                                                                                                
 18             gb.size++                                                                                               
 17         }                                                                                                           
 16     }                                                                                                               
 15 }                                                                                                                   
 14                                                                                                                     
 13 func (gb *GapBuffer) String() string {                                                                              
 12     return string(gb.data[:gb.size])                                                                                
 11 }                                                                                                                   
 10                                                                                                                     
  9 func main() {                                                                                                       
  8     gb := NewGapBuffer(10)                                                                                          
  7     gb.Insert([]rune("Hello"))                                                                                      
  6     gb.MoveGap(5)                                                                                                   
  5     gb.Insert([]rune(" World"))                                                                                     
  4     gb.Delete(5, 11)                                                                                                
  3     fmt.Println(gb.String()) // Output: Hello                                                                       
  2 }
